description: Check an OpenAPI document (JSON or YAML text, Swagger 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1) and get back a pass or a fix list an agent can act on: does it parse, which version, broken local $ref pointers, missing operationId or duplicate ones, operations without responses or without a response schema, path parameters that do not match the path, security requirements that name no scheme. Send the document itself as text: this tool never fetches a URL. Each finding says where, what is wrong and the fix. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/openapi-lint). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

document.description: The whole OpenAPI document as JSON or YAML text (up to 24,000 characters). A web address is refused: paste the document. Send specs without real personal data in examples; examples are not echoed.

name: openapi_lint
title: OpenAPI Spec Check
